title: Omujulirwa Omunywevu
intro: Ennyonnyola enzito egenda mu maaso, eraga obumalirivu obutasalako obw’ekitundu mu maaso g’obutyobooli obw’amaanyi ennyo. Emboozi yaabwe ekola ng’obujulizi obw’okukkiriza, ne bwe baba nga boolekedde ssaddaaka ey’enkomerero. Emboozi eno etujjukiza amaanyi g’okukkiriza okulwanyisa okunyigirizibwa okusukkiridde.
clues: Twali kibinja nga emboozi yaffe eyogerwako mu suura ennyimpi, ey’amaanyi, nga tulabula ku kuyigganyizibwa.
Twayolekagana n’omufuzi eyali ayagala okumalawo okukkiriza kwaffe mu Katonda Omu, Mukama w’Entebe, Atenderezebwa.
Twagezesebwa okw’entiisa okwali kuzingiramu ekinnya ekinene ennyo ekyasimibwa mu ttaka.
Twalaba ng’abakkiriza, nga mw’otwalidde n’abaana abawere, basuulibwa mu muliro ogw’amaanyi ogw’amaanyi munda mu kinnya ekyo.
Abatubonyaabonya baakolimirwa olw’ebikolwa byabwe, ate nga naffe twasuubizibwa empeera ey’ekitalo olw’obunywevu bwaffe.
Okugezaako kw’omufuzi okuzikiza okukkiriza kwaffe kwanyweza ekifo kyaffe ng’abajulizi mu maaso ga Allah, omujulizi ku bintu byonna.
arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
